args.title: Brightline Freight — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Brightline Freight’s latest newsletter highlights its “Cold-chain logistics in 2026” article and a related webinar.
• The article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece says pilot programs cut claims by 25%.
